newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Philippine Treasury bill auction delayed.
newsitem.headline: Philippine Treasury bill auction delayed.

text.p: The regular weekly auction of Philippine treasury bills was delayed by 30 minutes to 1.30 p.m. (0530 GMT) on Monday as communication problems prevented some banks from sending their bids on time, an official said.
About 19 banks and financial institutions could not send their bids before the deadline of 1.0 p.m.(0500 GMT), Bureau of Treasury director Roberto Juanchito Dispo said.
The bellwether 91-day treasury bill posted a yield of 10.529 percent at the last auction on June 2 and money market traders said they expected rates to fall at today's auction.
